summary: Batch A, family A15 (simple-graph triangle-freeness), on the fixed A14 pin f52251a. The existing canonical GTBase.base.triangle_free G := forall x y z : G, x -- y -> y -- z -> z -- x -> False is unchanged; no predicate is added. Chromatic X132/X187/X192 each wrote triangle-freeness as girth_geq G 4; the three helpers now unfold to triangle_free G. The equivalence is the existing proof of Topological.foundations.girth.girth_geq4_equiv_triangle_free (with triangle_ucycle and ucycle3_triangle), moved unchanged into GTBase.base after triangle_free; the Topological lemmas keep their qualified names and statements and delegate to base (no file imports that module). The independent bridges Chromatic.grounding_U8.triangle_free_girth and Extremal.implications_X13.girth_geq4_triangle_free (e063/e075) keep their own proofs and types. The genuine-cycle guard 2 < size c of girth_geq is untouched and is exactly what the bridge needs; the empty, one- and two-vertex and disconnected cases need no guard. Statements that already say girth_geq G 4 or quantify triples inline (X138/X150/X173/X219, U8) are statement text and stay.

Frozen verbatim at f52251a: the three helpers, X192's chain x192_polytime_additive_chromatic_approx and the whole rows X132 dvorak_norin_postle_planar_list_flexibility_statement (one p/q with 0 < p <= q for the 5/4/3 list cases, girth_geq G 5 kept), X187 planar_triangle_free_request_graph_fraction_statement (disproved; planarity, disjoint degree-two positive-weight request sets, exact cross-multiplied fraction; empty request sets and zero totals stay possible) and X192 triangle_free_minor_closed_chromatic_additive_approx_statement (alpha before the class, excluded-minor witness only). X192's chain bridge reuses the same program and polynomial-cost proof in both directions and converts only the triangle-free domain conjunct; both decoded-output bounds are untouched and no extensionality is used. Complete rows: X187 (text at C5's baseline a6db537) over this family's frozen helper and C5's frozen proper 3-colouring; X192 (text at C11's baseline 6e1a1c4) over C11's frozen excluded-minor class and this family's frozen chain. Each complete bridge converts the A15 pieces and reuses the earlier certificate.
